AmbiguousFileRead.title: AmbiguousFileRead
AmbiguousFileRead.description: A gold file name shared by several documents; the row can name one by hash.

ArtifactStatus.title: ArtifactStatus
ArtifactStatus.description: Lifecycle of a *pipeline artefact*, shared by parsing, chunking and index builds.

ChunkComparisonRead.title: ChunkComparisonRead
ChunkComparisonRead.description:
The same document chunked under two configurations, side by side.

Not required by the MVP, but it is *the* way to make the premise of the project tangible:
parsers and chunkers differ exactly where it matters, and a number cannot show that.

ChunkComparisonSide.title: ChunkComparisonSide
ChunkComparisonSide.description: The chunks a single configuration produced for the compared document.

ChunkRead.title: ChunkRead
ChunkRead.description:
A chunk as exposed by the API.

`metadata` carries the page the chunk came from, which is what lets the UI show *where*
in the document a chunk lives.

ChunkResultRead.title: ChunkResultRead
ChunkResultRead.description:
The state of a chunking artefact.

Parsing and chunking state is a property of the artefact and not of the document;
exposing it here rather than on `documents` keeps the API from inventing a status the
model does not have.

ChunkingConfigurationCompose.title: ChunkingConfigurationCompose
ChunkingConfigurationCompose.description:
Payload composing a configuration from two profiles given by value.

The shortcut behind a single UI form; the granular endpoints stay for anything that
references an existing profile by id.

ChunkingConfigurationComposed.title: ChunkingConfigurationComposed
ChunkingConfigurationComposed.description: Result of composing a configuration, one `created` flag per row involved.

ChunkingConfigurationCoverage.title: ChunkingConfigurationCoverage
ChunkingConfigurationCoverage.description:
How far a configuration has been materialised over a corpus.

The three counts always sum to `total`, which is what makes the answer trustworthy: a
document with no chunk result is `missing`, never absent.

ChunkingConfigurationCreate.title: ChunkingConfigurationCreate
ChunkingConfigurationCreate.description: Payload creating a configuration from two existing profiles.

ChunkingConfigurationCreated.title: ChunkingConfigurationCreated
ChunkingConfigurationCreated.description: A configuration with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

ChunkingConfigurationExpanded.title: ChunkingConfigurationExpanded
ChunkingConfigurationExpanded.description:
A configuration with its two profiles inlined.

Expanded server-side so the UI can label a row "pypdf + recursive512" in one call
instead of three.

ChunkingProfileCreate.title: ChunkingProfileCreate
ChunkingProfileCreate.description:
Payload creating a chunking profile.

`chunk_size` and `overlap` are promoted out of `params` because they are the two knobs
every chunker has and the ones a listing has to show without opening a JSON blob.

ChunkingProfileCreated.title: ChunkingProfileCreated
ChunkingProfileCreated.description: A chunking profile with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

ChunkingProfileRead.title: ChunkingProfileRead
ChunkingProfileRead.description: A chunking profile as exposed by the API.

ComponentRead.title: ComponentRead
ComponentRead.description: A component as exposed by the API.

ComponentVersionCreate.title: ComponentVersionCreate
ComponentVersionCreate.description: Payload registering a version of a component.

ComponentVersionRead.title: ComponentVersionRead
ComponentVersionRead.description: A component version as exposed by the API.

ComponentVersionUnavailable.title: ComponentVersionUnavailable
ComponentVersionUnavailable.description: Payload excluding a version from the available choices.

ComponentWithVersionsRead.title: ComponentWithVersionsRead
ComponentWithVersionsRead.description: A component together with its versions, so the UI builds its forms in one call.

detail.title: Detail
detail.default: the document was removed from the corpus; it still exists and existing snapshots keep their frozen composition

CorpusDocumentRemoved.title: CorpusDocumentRemoved
CorpusDocumentRemoved.description:
Result of detaching a document from a corpus.

States explicitly that the snapshots survive, because "remove" is the one word a user
could read as "delete the file and everything measured on it".

CorpusDocumentsAdd.title: CorpusDocumentsAdd
CorpusDocumentsAdd.description: Payload adding existing documents to a corpus.

CorpusDocumentsAdded.title: CorpusDocumentsAdded
CorpusDocumentsAdded.description: Result of adding documents to a corpus.

CorpusProgress.title: CorpusProgress
CorpusProgress.description: Acquisition progress of a corpus, one count per document status.

CorpusRead.title: CorpusRead
CorpusRead.description: A corpus as exposed by the API.

CorpusSnapshotCreate.title: CorpusSnapshotCreate
CorpusSnapshotCreate.description: Payload freezing a snapshot; without `document_ids` every stored document is taken.

CorpusSnapshotCreated.title: CorpusSnapshotCreated
CorpusSnapshotCreated.description: A snapshot with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

CorpusSnapshotRead.title: CorpusSnapshotRead
CorpusSnapshotRead.description: A frozen selection of documents as exposed by the API.

CorpusUpdate.title: CorpusUpdate
CorpusUpdate.description: Payload updating a corpus; omitted fields are left unchanged.

CoverageRead.title: CoverageRead
CoverageRead.description: How much of a QA snapshot a corpus snapshot can answer.

DocumentChunksRead.title: DocumentChunksRead
DocumentChunksRead.description: One page of the chunks of a document, with the state of the artefact holding them.

DocumentFailureRead.title: DocumentFailureRead
DocumentFailureRead.description: Why one document of a run produced no chunks.

DocumentMetadataUpdate.title: DocumentMetadataUpdate
DocumentMetadataUpdate.description:
Payload replacing the metadata of a document.

The shape is free because the keys become retrieval filters and are not known to the
platform; it is a filter surface and not a notes field.

DocumentParseRead.title: DocumentParseRead
DocumentParseRead.description:
One window of the per-page text of a parse.

Paginated by page: this is the diagnostic view for "the chunking looks strange", which
almost always means "the parse looks strange", and the pages are megabytes of text.

DocumentProvenanceRead.title: DocumentProvenanceRead
DocumentProvenanceRead.description: Where one copy of a document came from.

DocumentRead.title: DocumentRead
DocumentRead.description:
A document as exposed by the API.

`content_hash` is always exposed: it is the identity the platform deduplicates on, so
it is also the only way a user can tell that the file they just uploaded is the one
already in the list.

DocumentStatus.title: DocumentStatus
DocumentStatus.description: Lifecycle of a file *acquisition*: fetched, hashed, stored.

DocumentWithProvenancesRead.title: DocumentWithProvenancesRead
DocumentWithProvenancesRead.description: A document together with its origins, so the UI resolves the original.

EmbeddingProfileCreated.title: EmbeddingProfileCreated
EmbeddingProfileCreated.description: An embedding profile with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

EmbeddingProfileRead.title: EmbeddingProfileRead
EmbeddingProfileRead.description: An embedding profile as exposed by the API.

EvidenceChunkRead.title: EvidenceChunkRead
EvidenceChunkRead.description: An evidence chunk with where it comes from, for the review panel.

EvidenceChunkWrite.title: EvidenceChunkWrite
EvidenceChunkWrite.description: A chunk chosen as evidence, sufficient on its own or supporting the answer.

EvidenceCoverageRead.title: EvidenceCoverageRead
EvidenceCoverageRead.description: How far the evidence of a set is reviewed under one configuration.

EvidenceLinkStatus.title: EvidenceLinkStatus
EvidenceLinkStatus.description:
Review state of the chunks that hold the answer, under one chunking configuration.

No row at all means "not reviewed yet"; `not_found` is a checked outcome: the evidence
does not exist in the chunks of that configuration.

EvidenceRead.title: EvidenceRead
EvidenceRead.description:
The evidence of a question under one chunking configuration.

`added_gold_document_ids` lists the documents a confirmation added to the gold.

EvidenceWrite.title: EvidenceWrite
EvidenceWrite.description:
The whole evidence of a question under one chunking configuration.

`to_review` saves a draft; `confirmed` needs chunks; `not_found` takes none. Both
decisions need `annotator`.

ExecutionStatus.title: ExecutionStatus
ExecutionStatus.description: Lifecycle of a run and of each of its executions.

ExpectedAnswerRead.title: ExpectedAnswerRead
ExpectedAnswerRead.description: An acceptable answer to a question; the primary one comes first.

ExpectedAnswerWrite.title: ExpectedAnswerWrite
ExpectedAnswerWrite.description: An acceptable answer; with none marked primary, the first one is.

uncovered_policy.title: Uncovered Policy
uncovered_policy.description: Required when some questions have gold documents outside the corpus snapshot: `exclude` runs them but leaves them out of the metrics' denominator.

ExperimentDetail.title: ExperimentDetail
ExperimentDetail.description: An experiment with its variants, runs and gold coverage.

ExportFormat.title: ExportFormat
ExportFormat.description: File formats of an export: the same two the import reads.

GoldDocumentRead.title: GoldDocumentRead
GoldDocumentRead.description: A document that contains the answer to a question.

GoldDocumentsWrite.title: GoldDocumentsWrite
GoldDocumentsWrite.description: The complete list of gold documents of a question.

HitDetailRead.title: HitDetailRead
HitDetailRead.description: A retrieved chunk with the document it comes from and whether it counted as relevant.

ImportSummaryRead.title: ImportSummaryRead
ImportSummaryRead.description:
What an import did, row by row: nothing is dropped without being listed.

`existing` are rows whose question text was already in the set: questions are
immutable, so a re-import leaves them as they are instead of duplicating them.

ImportedQuestionRead.title: ImportedQuestionRead
ImportedQuestionRead.description: A row turned into a question.

IndexBuildAccepted.title: IndexBuildAccepted
IndexBuildAccepted.description: A launched index build, stating whether this request is what started it.

IndexBuildCreate.title: IndexBuildCreate
IndexBuildCreate.description: Payload creating an index build from an existing snapshot and profile chain.

IndexBuildCreated.title: IndexBuildCreated
IndexBuildCreated.description: An index build with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

IndexBuildDetail.title: IndexBuildDetail
IndexBuildDetail.description: An index build with the number of chunks it indexes.

IndexBuildRead.title: IndexBuildRead
IndexBuildRead.description: A vector DB population configuration as exposed by the API.

InvalidRowRead.title: InvalidRowRead
InvalidRowRead.description: A malformed row, e.g. an empty question or an answerable one without gold files.

MaterializationAccepted.title: MaterializationAccepted
MaterializationAccepted.description:
A launched run, stating whether this request is what started it.

`started` is false when the deterministic workflow id was already running: two identical
launches produce one workflow and two `202`s with the same `id`, because a double click is
not a user error.

MaterializationCreate.title: MaterializationCreate
MaterializationCreate.description:
Payload launching a materialisation.

Either an explicit document list — the preview on a few files — or a corpus,
whose documents are resolved server-side. The same endpoint and the same workflow serve
both, so a preview is exactly what the full run will do.

MaterializationDetail.title: MaterializationDetail
MaterializationDetail.description: A run with the reason of each document that failed.

MaterializationProgress.title: MaterializationProgress
MaterializationProgress.description: The four counters of a run; they always sum to `document_count`.

MaterializationRead.title: MaterializationRead
MaterializationRead.description:
A materialisation run as exposed by the API.

Denormalised on purpose: the UI polls this every couple of seconds and must not
make Temporal answer each refresh. The authoritative state stays in Temporal.

MetricResultRead.title: MetricResultRead
MetricResultRead.description: Statistics of one metric for one variant, always with how many scores they rest on.

ParsePageRead.title: ParsePageRead
ParsePageRead.description: The text of one page of a parse.

ParsingProfileCreated.title: ParsingProfileCreated
ParsingProfileCreated.description: A parsing profile with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

ParsingProfileRead.title: ParsingProfileRead
ParsingProfileRead.description: A parsing profile as exposed by the API.

ProgressRead.title: ProgressRead
ProgressRead.description: Execution counters of a run: pending includes the ones still running.

origin_corpus_id.title: Origin Corpus Id
origin_corpus_id.description: Corpus the gold file names of an import are resolved in.

QASetDetail.title: QASetDetail
QASetDetail.description: A QA set with one page of its questions.

QASetRead.title: QASetRead
QASetRead.description: A QA set as exposed by the API.

QASetSnapshotCreate.title: QASetSnapshotCreate
QASetSnapshotCreate.description: Payload freezing the current questions of a set.

QASetSnapshotCreated.title: QASetSnapshotCreated
QASetSnapshotCreated.description: A snapshot with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

QASetSnapshotRead.title: QASetSnapshotRead
QASetSnapshotRead.description: An immutable freeze of a QA set.

QuestionCreate.title: QuestionCreate
QuestionCreate.description: A question written in the UI; gold documents can also come later, from evidence.

QuestionDrilldownRead.title: QuestionDrilldownRead
QuestionDrilldownRead.description: What each variant returned for one question, side by side.

QuestionRead.title: QuestionRead
QuestionRead.description:
A question with its gold documents and expected answers.

`frozen` is true when a snapshot holds the question: it can then only be replaced.
`evidence_status` is set when the listing was asked for a chunking configuration.

QuestionUpdate.title: QuestionUpdate
QuestionUpdate.description:
Changes to a question not frozen yet; an omitted field is left as it is.

`expected_answers`, when given, replaces the whole list.

QuestionVariantOutcomeRead.title: QuestionVariantOutcomeRead
QuestionVariantOutcomeRead.description: How one variant did on a question, on its first repetition.

RelevanceGrade.title: RelevanceGrade
RelevanceGrade.description: Whether a gold chunk answers the question on its own or only supports the answer.

RetrievalProfileCreate.title: RetrievalProfileCreate
RetrievalProfileCreate.description:
Payload creating a retrieval profile.

Only `dense` is executable today; the other strategies are refused with a `422`.

RetrievalProfileCreated.title: RetrievalProfileCreated
RetrievalProfileCreated.description: A retrieval profile with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

RetrievalProfileRead.title: RetrievalProfileRead
RetrievalProfileRead.description: A retrieval profile as exposed by the API: the fields the engine applies today.

RetrievalScope.title: RetrievalScope
RetrievalScope.description: Which chunks a metric is computed on: what was retrieved, put in context or cited.

RetrievalStrategy.title: RetrievalStrategy
RetrievalStrategy.description: How the vector store is searched; only `dense` is executable today.

RetrievalTimingsRead.title: RetrievalTimingsRead
RetrievalTimingsRead.description: Milliseconds spent embedding the query, searching and reading the chunks back.

execution_id.title: Execution Id
execution_id.description: Experiment execution the call belongs to; absent for a test query.

RetrieveRequest.title: RetrieveRequest
RetrieveRequest.description: A query against one index build, under one retrieval profile.

RetrieveResponse.title: RetrieveResponse
RetrieveResponse.description:
Hits ranked from 1, best first; scores are higher-is-better on every store.

`corpus_id` and `chunking_configuration_id` are returned so a client can open each hit
in its document without further lookups.

RetrievedHitRead.title: RetrievedHitRead
RetrievedHitRead.description:
One retrieved chunk.

`chunk_id` is null when the vector store returned a vector whose chunk no longer
exists in the database; `text` then holds what the vector store kept.

RunAccepted.title: RunAccepted
RunAccepted.description: A launched run, stating whether this request is what started its workflow.

RunDetail.title: RunDetail
RunDetail.description: A run with the full configuration copied at launch.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Queries processed at once; lower it when the embedder rate limits.

RunLaunchRequest.title: RunLaunchRequest
RunLaunchRequest.description: Optional parameters of a run launch.

RunQuestionRead.title: RunQuestionRead
RunQuestionRead.description: A question of the run with the outcome of each variant.

RunRead.title: RunRead
RunRead.description: A run with its denormalised progress, as polled by the UI.

RunResultsRead.title: RunResultsRead
RunResultsRead.description: The aggregated metrics of a run, per variant, with the snapshots they were measured on.

SnapshotDeclaredRead.title: SnapshotDeclaredRead
SnapshotDeclaredRead.description: The snapshot a result was computed on: a metric is meaningless without it.

UncoveredQuestionRead.title: UncoveredQuestionRead
UncoveredQuestionRead.description: A question with gold documents missing from the corpus snapshot.

UnresolvedRowRead.title: UnresolvedRowRead
UnresolvedRowRead.description: A row whose gold files match no document of the corpus.

UploadFileResult.title: UploadFileResult
UploadFileResult.description: Outcome of one file of an upload request.

UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse
UploadResponse.description:
Summary of an upload request, one entry per submitted file.

Returned with `200` even when some files were rejected: the outcome is per file, and a
single unsupported attachment must not discard the batch.

VariantCreate.title: VariantCreate
VariantCreate.description: A variant: an index build searched under a retrieval profile.

VariantRead.title: VariantRead
VariantRead.description: A variant with the index build and retrieval profile it points at.

VectorStoreProfileCreate.title: VectorStoreProfileCreate
VectorStoreProfileCreate.description: Payload creating a vector store profile.

VectorStoreProfileCreated.title: VectorStoreProfileCreated
VectorStoreProfileCreated.description: A vector store profile with the outcome of the get-or-create that returned it.

VectorStoreProfileRead.title: VectorStoreProfileRead
VectorStoreProfileRead.description: A vector store profile as exposed by the API.
